title: Carbon
subtitle: 「碳排放／溫室氣體排放／碳足跡」，本單元只處理氣候與環境語境中的 carbon 簡寫。
description: 「碳排放／溫室氣體排放／碳足跡」，本單元只處理氣候與環境語境中的 carbon 簡寫。

words.example: The new policy aims to reduce carbon emissions from transport.
words.exampleZh: 新政策旨在減少交通運輸的碳排放。

exercises.original: The city wants to cut carbon from road transport by 30 percent.
exercises.zh: 城市希望把道路交通的碳排放削減三成。
exercises.upgrade: The city wants to cut carbon emissions from road transport by 30 percent.

options.explanation: cut carbon from road transport 在氣候語境中自然展開為 carbon emissions，語義最直接。
CO 是另一種氣體，不能把一般碳排放改成一氧化碳。
範圍更廣，可包括粒子和 NOx，未必等於氣候排放。
能源消耗可能造成排放，但不是排放本身。
是排放來源，不是排放結果。
煙不是 CO₂／GHG 排放的同義詞。

exercises.original: The company has promised to reduce its carbon over the next decade.
exercises.zh: 公司承諾在未來十年減少碳排放。
exercises.upgrade: The company has promised to reduce its carbon emissions over the next decade.

options.explanation: 太廣，可能指多種污染形式。
company reduce its carbon 是企業氣候語境的標準展開。
公司可以減少能源使用，但兩者不是等義。
是能源來源，不是排放量。

exercises.original: Transport accounts for a large share of national carbon.
exercises.zh: 交通運輸佔全國碳排放很大部分。
exercises.upgrade: Transport accounts for a large share of national carbon emissions.

options.explanation: footprint 通常歸屬於活動／產品／組織整體，不是 national share 的首選展開。
national carbon 在排放統計語境自然指 national carbon emissions。
是環境結果指標，不是排放量。

words.example: Switching to cleaner electricity can reduce carbon dioxide emissions.
words.exampleZh: 改用較潔淨的電力可以減少二氧化碳排放。

exercises.original: Burning the fuel releases large amounts of carbon into the atmosphere, mainly as CO2.
exercises.zh: 燃燒這種燃料會向大氣排放大量二氧化碳。
exercises.upgrade: Burning the fuel releases large amounts of carbon dioxide emissions into the atmosphere.

options.explanation: 題目明確說 mainly as CO2，因此應精準指二氧化碳排放。
範圍更廣，會把甲烷等也算進去，超出原句。

exercises.original: The report measures carbon from electricity generation but excludes methane.
exercises.zh: 報告量度發電造成的二氧化碳排放，但不包括甲烷。
exercises.upgrade: The report measures carbon dioxide emissions from electricity generation but excludes methane.

options.explanation: 若排除 methane 等其他氣體，GHG 會過廣。
excludes methane 明確界定只計 CO₂。
footprint 是整體歸因概念，這裡只量度發電排放。

exercises.original: Vehicle standards are intended to lower carbon released as CO2.
exercises.zh: 車輛標準旨在降低以二氧化碳形式排放的碳。
exercises.upgrade: Vehicle standards are intended to lower carbon dioxide emissions.

options.explanation: 整體足跡比 tailpipe CO₂ emissions 更廣。
released as CO2 是直接線索。

words.example: The chart shows a decline in CO2 emissions per person.
words.exampleZh: 圖表顯示人均二氧化碳排放下降。

exercises.original: The chart compares carbon dioxide emissions per person across countries.
exercises.zh: 圖表比較各國人均二氧化碳排放。
exercises.upgrade: The chart compares CO2 emissions per person across countries.

options.explanation: 是 carbon dioxide emissions 的標準縮寫，圖表語境尤其常見。
比 CO₂ 更廣，不一定同一數據。
不是單純國家人均 CO₂ 統計的同義詞。

exercises.original: The new engine produces less carbon dioxide emissions than the old one.
exercises.zh: 新引擎產生的二氧化碳排放比舊引擎少。
exercises.upgrade: The new engine produces less CO2 emissions than the old one.

options.explanation: 只是完整術語的簡寫，語義不變。

exercises.original: The target focuses specifically on carbon dioxide emissions from buildings.
exercises.zh: 目標特別針對建築物的二氧化碳排放。
exercises.upgrade: The target focuses specifically on CO2 emissions from buildings.

options.explanation: specifically carbon dioxide 表示不應擴大至所有 GHG。

words.example: Agriculture accounts for a significant share of greenhouse-gas emissions.
words.exampleZh: 農業佔溫室氣體排放的重要部分。

exercises.original: The climate plan aims to cut carbon, including methane and nitrous oxide.
exercises.zh: 氣候計劃旨在削減包括甲烷和氧化亞氮在內的溫室氣體排放。
exercises.upgrade: The climate plan aims to cut greenhouse-gas emissions, including methane and nitrous oxide.

options.explanation: 題目明確還包括 methane 和 nitrous oxide，因此只說 CO₂ 太窄。
涵蓋多種致暖氣體，最精準。

exercises.original: Agriculture produces carbon through methane, nitrous oxide and carbon dioxide.
exercises.zh: 農業透過甲烷、氧化亞氮和二氧化碳產生溫室氣體排放。
exercises.upgrade: Agriculture produces greenhouse-gas emissions through methane, nitrous oxide and carbon dioxide.

options.explanation: 無法涵蓋 methane 和 nitrous oxide。
三種氣體都屬氣候盤查中的 GHG。
methane/nitrous oxide 並非只來自化石燃料。

exercises.original: The national target covers all major carbon gases, not just CO2.
exercises.zh: 國家目標涵蓋所有主要溫室氣體，而不只二氧化碳。
exercises.upgrade: The national target covers all major greenhouse-gas emissions, not just CO2.

options.explanation: 和 not just CO2 直接矛盾。

words.example: The company publishes its GHG emissions inventory each year.
words.exampleZh: 公司每年公布其溫室氣體排放清單。

exercises.original: The company reports its greenhouse-gas emissions every year.
exercises.zh: 公司每年公布溫室氣體排放。
exercises.upgrade: The company reports its GHG emissions every year.

options.explanation: 是 greenhouse-gas emissions 的標準專業縮寫。
CO 是一氧化碳，完全不同。
可以與年度盤查相關，但不是這個術語的直接縮寫。

exercises.original: The inventory lists scope 1 and scope 2 greenhouse-gas emissions.
exercises.zh: 盤查列出範疇一和範疇二溫室氣體排放。
exercises.upgrade: The inventory lists scope 1 and scope 2 GHG emissions.

options.explanation: 較描述性，正式盤查更標準用 GHG emissions。
inventory + scope 1/scope 2 是典型企業 GHG 盤查語境。
scope inventory 可能涵蓋多種溫室氣體，不一定只 CO₂。

exercises.original: The project has a target to reduce greenhouse-gas emissions by 40 percent.
exercises.zh: 項目設定把溫室氣體排放減少四成的目標。
exercises.upgrade: The project has a target to reduce GHG emissions by 40 percent.

options.explanation: 可能受影響，但 reduction target 的原詞是 emissions。

words.meaning: 溫室氣體排放量；溫室氣體產出
words.example: The upgrade reduced the plant's greenhouse-gas output.
words.exampleZh: 升級工程減少了工廠的溫室氣體排放量。

exercises.original: The upgrade reduced the factory's carbon output across all greenhouse gases.
exercises.zh: 升級工程減少了工廠的整體溫室氣體排放量。
exercises.upgrade: The upgrade reduced the factory's greenhouse-gas output.

options.explanation: across all greenhouse gases 表示重點是整體 GHG 排放量。
太窄，沒有涵蓋其他氣體。

exercises.original: The new process lowers greenhouse-gas emissions from production.
exercises.zh: 新工序降低生產過程的溫室氣體排放量。
exercises.upgrade: The new process lowers greenhouse-gas output from production.

options.explanation: output 直接突出產生多少 GHG。

exercises.original: The report compares greenhouse-gas emissions from several industrial processes.
exercises.zh: 報告比較多種工業程序的溫室氣體排放量。
exercises.upgrade: The report compares greenhouse-gas output from several industrial processes.

options.explanation: 若原數據是所有 GHG，這會縮窄範圍。
compares output from processes 語義自然。

words.example: The city wants to cut emissions from road transport.
words.exampleZh: 城市希望削減道路交通的排放。

exercises.original: The transport strategy aims to lower carbon emissions from cars and buses.
exercises.zh: 交通策略旨在降低汽車和巴士排放。
exercises.upgrade: The transport strategy aims to lower emissions from cars and buses.

options.explanation: 在交通和碳政策上下文中，省略 carbon 後仍清楚指排放。
車輛能源消耗和排放不是同一數值。
現代車輛排放很多是不可見氣體。
過度縮窄成單一污染物。

exercises.original: The factory has reduced its carbon emissions significantly.
exercises.zh: 工廠已大幅減少排放。
exercises.upgrade: The factory has reduced its emissions significantly.

options.explanation: 太廣，可能包括水污染和廢物。
上下文已清楚是氣體排放，簡化自然。

exercises.original: National carbon emissions fell for the second year in a row.
exercises.zh: 全國排放連續第二年下降。
exercises.upgrade: National emissions fell for the second year in a row.

options.explanation: national climate context 足以支撐簡化。

words.meaning: 氣候相關排放；溫室氣體排放
words.example: The plan sets new targets for cutting climate emissions.
words.exampleZh: 計劃設定新的氣候排放削減目標。

exercises.original: The policy sets a target for reducing national carbon emissions by 2040.
exercises.zh: 政策設定在2040年前減少全國氣候相關排放的目標。
exercises.upgrade: The policy sets a target for reducing national climate emissions by 2040.

options.explanation: 政策語境中可通俗指造成氣候變化的排放。

exercises.original: Heavy industry remains a major source of carbon affecting the climate.
exercises.zh: 重工業仍是氣候排放的重要來源。
exercises.upgrade: Heavy industry remains a major source of climate emissions.

options.explanation: 原句 broader climate impact 未限定只 CO₂。
概括所有造成氣候影響的排放，媒體／政策語境自然。

exercises.original: The government wants faster cuts in carbon across the economy.
exercises.zh: 政府希望更快削減全經濟的氣候排放。
exercises.upgrade: The government wants faster cuts in climate emissions across the economy.

options.explanation: across the economy + cuts 是政策語境自然表達。

words.example: Efficiency measures lowered the factory's carbon output.
words.exampleZh: 提升效率的措施降低了工廠的碳排放量。

exercises.original: Efficiency improvements reduced the plant's carbon emissions.
exercises.zh: 提升效率的措施降低了工廠的碳排放量。
exercises.upgrade: Efficiency improvements reduced the plant's carbon output.

options.explanation: plant's amount of carbon-related emissions 可自然描述為 carbon output。
可能同時下降，但不是同義。

exercises.original: The company tracks the carbon it produces each year.
exercises.zh: 公司追蹤每年產生的碳排放量。
exercises.upgrade: The company tracks its annual carbon output.

options.explanation: 也可能用於企業整體影響，但 produced each year 更直接是 output。
annual amount produced 的語義最貼切。

exercises.original: The factory's carbon fell after the equipment upgrade.
exercises.zh: 設備升級後工廠的碳排放量下降。
exercises.upgrade: The factory's carbon output fell after the equipment upgrade.

options.explanation: factory's carbon 作數量指標自然展開。

words.example: Taking the train can reduce the carbon footprint of a journey.
words.exampleZh: 乘搭火車可以減少一趟旅程的碳足跡。

exercises.original: Taking the train can reduce the carbon associated with a journey.
exercises.zh: 乘搭火車可以減少一趟旅程的整體碳足跡。
exercises.upgrade: Taking the train can reduce the carbon footprint of a journey.

options.explanation: journey-associated total climate impact 是典型 footprint 概念。
指大氣濃度，不是旅程排放。
只是形成足跡的一部分。

exercises.original: The company is trying to shrink the carbon linked to its operations and supply chain.
exercises.zh: 公司正嘗試縮小營運和供應鏈相關的碳足跡。
exercises.upgrade: The company is trying to shrink the carbon footprint linked to its operations and supply chain.

options.explanation: 可描述直接排放，但 supply chain 會涉及更廣歸因邊界。
operations + supply chain 是企業整體 footprint 的典型範圍。

exercises.original: The product's carbon includes emissions from manufacturing, transport and disposal.
exercises.zh: 產品碳足跡包括製造、運輸和棄置所產生的排放。
exercises.upgrade: The product's carbon footprint includes emissions from manufacturing, transport and disposal.

options.explanation: product lifecycle 可能涵蓋多種 GHG，且題目強調整體生命週期。
manufacturing + transport + disposal 是產品足跡典型邊界。

words.example: The project is expected to avoid 5,000 tonnes of carbon-dioxide equivalent emissions each year.
words.exampleZh: 項目預計每年可避免五千噸二氧化碳當量排放。

exercises.original: The inventory converts methane and other gases into a common carbon measure.
exercises.zh: 盤查把甲烷和其他氣體換算成共同的二氧化碳當量排放。
exercises.upgrade: The inventory reports carbon-dioxide equivalent emissions.

options.explanation: different gases converted into one warming-equivalent measure 就是 CO₂e。
會錯誤地把其他氣體當成真正 CO₂。

exercises.original: The project avoids emissions from several greenhouse gases, reported in one common unit.
exercises.zh: 項目避免多種溫室氣體排放，並以共同單位報告。
exercises.upgrade: The project avoids carbon-dioxide equivalent emissions, reported in one common unit.

options.explanation: 只是氣體清單，不表示換算共同單位。
one common unit 是 CO₂e 的核心。

exercises.original: The footprint is expressed as tonnes of carbon equivalent.
exercises.zh: 這個足跡以噸二氧化碳當量表示。
exercises.upgrade: The footprint is expressed as tonnes of carbon-dioxide equivalent emissions.

options.explanation: 不代表其他氣體的等效暖化影響。
tonnes of equivalent 是明確計量線索。

words.note: 語域：technical / very common in climate reporting
words.example: The product generates 12 kg CO2e over its lifecycle.
words.exampleZh: 該產品在整個生命週期產生十二公斤二氧化碳當量排放。

exercises.original: The product generates 12 kilograms of carbon equivalent over its lifecycle.
exercises.zh: 產品整個生命週期產生十二公斤二氧化碳當量排放。
exercises.upgrade: The product generates 12 kilograms of CO2e emissions over its lifecycle.

options.explanation: lifecycle + kilograms of carbon equivalent 是標準產品足跡單位。
CO 是一氧化碳，不是 equivalent 單位。

exercises.original: The report gives total greenhouse-gas impact in tonnes of carbon equivalent.
exercises.zh: 報告以噸二氧化碳當量列出溫室氣體總影響。
exercises.upgrade: The report gives total GHG impact in tonnes of CO2e emissions.

options.explanation: total GHG impact 不應縮成實際 CO₂ 一種氣體。
用共同 warming-equivalent 單位表示總 GHG。

exercises.original: The event's carbon is reported as 4.6 tonnes CO2 equivalent.
exercises.zh: 活動的碳影響以4.6噸二氧化碳當量報告。
exercises.upgrade: The event's emissions are reported as 4.6 tonnes CO2e.

options.explanation: tonnes CO2 equivalent 的標準縮寫。

words.meaning: 排放足跡；整體排放影響
words.example: The redesign reduced the product's overall emissions footprint.
words.exampleZh: 重新設計降低了產品的整體排放足跡。

exercises.original: The redesign reduced the product's overall carbon footprint.
exercises.zh: 重新設計降低了產品的整體排放足跡。
exercises.upgrade: The redesign reduced the product's overall emissions footprint.

options.explanation: overall attributed emissions impact 可作 carbon footprint 的描述性改寫。
只是影響足跡的其中一項因素。

exercises.original: The organisation wants to lower the carbon footprint of its operations.
exercises.zh: 機構希望降低其營運的整體排放足跡。
exercises.upgrade: The organisation wants to lower the emissions footprint of its operations.

options.explanation: 可能偏直接排放量，未必涵蓋整體 operational footprint。
強調營運整體歸因排放。

exercises.original: The company is assessing the carbon footprint of the entire project.
exercises.zh: 公司正在評估整個項目的排放足跡。
exercises.upgrade: The company is assessing the emissions footprint of the entire project.

options.explanation: entire project 的整體排放影響最貼切。

falseSynonyms.zh: 元素碳不等於排放 carbon 本義是化學元素 C。只有在氣候／環境語境中，它才常被當作 carbon emissions / carbon footprint 的簡寫。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Carbon is an element; 'carbon' as shorthand for emissions depends on context.

falseSynonyms.zh: 一氧化碳不等於 carbon dioxide carbon monoxide 是 CO，主要是有毒空氣污染物；carbon dioxide 是 CO₂，兩者化學物質和氣候角色不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON CO and CO₂ are different gases and must not be treated as synonyms.

falseSynonyms.zh: 空氣污染比 carbon emissions 更廣 air pollution 可包括粒子、氮氧化物、二氧化硫、臭氧等；碳／溫室氣體排放只是另一類環境指標。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Air pollution and greenhouse-gas emissions overlap in sources but are not the same concept.

falseSynonyms.zh: 煙不等於碳排放 smoke 是可見或不可見燃燒產物的混合物；很多 CO₂ 排放完全看不見，也不等於 smoke。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Carbon dioxide is invisible; smoke is a different physical mixture.

falseSynonyms.zh: 污染過於寬泛 pollution 可指空氣、水、噪音、化學污染等；不能用來精準替代 carbon emissions。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Pollution is a much broader category than carbon or greenhouse-gas emissions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 能源使用不等於排放 energy use 可能導致排放，但若能源來自低碳來源，能源使用量和碳排放量並不相同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Energy consumption can cause emissions, but the relationship depends on the energy source.

falseSynonyms.zh: 化石燃料不等於排放 fossil fuels 是煤、石油、天然氣等能源來源；燃燒它們會造成排放，但來源和排放結果不是同義。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Fossil fuels are sources; emissions are outputs.

falseSynonyms.zh: 碳足跡不總等於單次 carbon emissions carbon footprint 通常是某人、產品、組織或活動整體歸因的溫室氣體排放總量；範圍比單一排放值更完整。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A footprint is an attributed total; an emission can be one component of that total.
